# POST-SURGICAL OR POST-TRAUMATIC BRAIN ABSCESS

Prior to beginning antimicrobial therapy, when possible, computed topographic
(CT) - guided aspiration or surgery should be performed to obtain abscess
material for determination of infectious pathogen. Adjust antimicrobial regimen
to optimize therapy based on pathogen once isolated.

Broad spectrum empiric antimicrobials are indicated initially for brain abscess.

Staphylococcus aureus is a common pathogen. Beta-lactam antibiotics are more
effective than vancomycin for susceptible Staphylococci. If Staphylococcus is
isolated, once methicillin- resistance is ruled out, switch to an
anti-staphylococcal beta-lactam antibiotic. Pseudomonas is a potential pathogen
in post-surgical patients, and those who are known to be colonized with
Pseudomonas.

# Consult Neurosurgery, Neurology, and Infectious Disease

# Post-Surgical Empiric Treatment

Preferred:

[Cefepime 2gm IV Q8h \($$\) R <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h \($\) R](orz-set-abx-cefepime-2gm-iv-q8h-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)

Alternative:

[Assessment of beta-lactam reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Meropenem 2 gm IV q8h \($$\) R,O <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h \($\) R](orz-set-abx-meropenem-2gm-iv-q8h-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)

# Post Traumatic Empiric Treatment

Preferred if pseudomonas is not suspected and paranasal sinuses are not
involved:

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q12h \($\) M <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h \($\) R](orz-set-abx-vancom-15mg-kg-iv-q12h-ceft-2gm-iv-q12h)

Preferred if Pseudomonas is suspected and paranasal sinuses are not involved:

[Cefepime 2gm IV Q8h \($$\) R <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h \($\) R](orz-set-abx-cefepime-2gm-iv-q8h-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)

If paranasal sinuses are involved or alternative:

[Assessment of beta-lactam reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Meropenem 2 gm IV q8h \($$\) R,O <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h \($\) R](orz-set-abx-meropenem-2gm-iv-q8h-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)
